instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\library_part.step. Manually define the required tools in the SolidCAM Tool Table, then create Face, Drill, and Profile operations on C:\Users\User\Desktop\library_part.step. Tool definitions to create manually in SolidCAM Tool Table: T1 face/end mill, T2 drill, T3 profile end mill, and T4 finishing tool matching the required operations. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-12.nc.
